What is the cancellation policy?

Patients may cancel an appointment up to 24 hours before the scheduled consultation without any penalty. 
Cancellations made within 24 hours may not qualify for a full refund. 
Rescheduling is subject to doctor availability. 
Refunds, when applicable, are processed within 5 to 7 business days.
